label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Conforme a todo lo que yo mostrando a ti, el modelo del mishkán y el modelo de todos sus utensilios, y así harán.
spanish: Conforme a todo lo que yo te muestro, el modelo del tabernáculo y el modelo de todos sus utensilios, y así harán.

units.es: Conforme a todo lo que yo te muestro
y el modelo de todos sus utensilios

grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated lemma mishkán into Spanish as tabernáculo for הַמִּשְׁכָּן (definite, masculine singular common noun).
Replaced the bare gerund 'mostrando' with the finite present 'te muestro' to supply the relative clause's missing predicate, keeping the showing sense of the Hiphil participle with its 1cs subject.
Replaced the calque 'a ti' with the clitic object pronoun 'te' required by Spanish word order for the same direct-object sense.
readerNote: Chose the finite present 'te muestro' over the ungrammatical gerund to give the relative clause a predicate while keeping the same showing sense.
